paragraphs: Mentioned in Zevachim 9b, where Rav Yehudah reported in his name. Rashi explains that this is a sage’s name.[^1]

notes.text: Rav Yehudah is understood to report in Mevug’s name. The parenthesis attributes the explanation “a sage’s name” to Rashi, not a fresh place or identity finding. ט: gives Zevachim 9b under the colon convention, without independent named-edition verification. Rav is full; the heading supplies no title.
